thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging @oncall — high error spike on /v1/generate (hosted). Root ts 1750004321

maria: seeing 5xx rate jump ~09:03 UTC. Canary (model: redwood/opt-7b-canary-v3) shows increased p50/p95 latency + 502s.

aj: yep I got pager. Reproducing locally against canary – hitting timeout in token-streaming path. Logs show `KV cache miss` explosions.

kevin: any recent infra changes? autoscaler? kernel?

maria: nothing infra-side. We rolled canary 20m before incident: `deploy canary redwood/opt-7b-canary-v3 -> 10% traffic`

sophia: customers flagged: multiple mid-size tenants seeing conversation truncation and 502s. Affected: customer-42, guild-api, acme-inbox (support tickets started).

maria: quick mitigation idea: divert canary traffic to stable pool, pin canary back to v2, and keep canary offline while we investigate. Need approvals for immediate rollback.

kevin: +1 to divert. Sophia, coordinate CS comms.

aj: starting live timeline build here — adding raw logs and diffs.

aj: CAPTURED: sample log snippet (09:05 UTC)

```
2025-11-14T09:05:12Z ERROR serve: request_id=abcd1234 handler=token_streaming err="upstream read timeout" model=redwood/opt-7b-canary-v3 kv_cache_misses=4823 seq_len=512
```

aj: Canary diff between v2 and v3 (profiled on same hardware):

```
- v2 p50=55ms p95=210ms kv_hit_rate=94%
+ v3 p50=120ms p95=820ms kv_hit_rate=68%
```

maria: ^ that's huge. KV hit rate drop explains cost and latency. Hypothesis 1: change in keying or cache keys introduced in v3 (maybe padding or new tokenization).

sophia: Hypothesis 2: quantization change in v3 altering memory layout causing more evictions under same batch sizes.

kevin: record both hypotheses in thread. We should run a quick canary config check: verify model checksum + rollout config.

aj: running `redwoodctl rollout status --model redwood/opt-7b-canary-v3` -> shows 10% traffic, origin commit `f1e2d3`. Fetching deployment config...

aj: config snippet:

```
image: rwd/inference:opt-7b-canary-v3
quant: int8_dynamic
kv_sharding: enabled
kv_key_prefix: "prompt_v2"
```

aj: kv_key_prefix changed from `prompt` -> `prompt_v2` in this build. That matches hypothesis 1.

maria: ok that's our smoking gun for the cache behavior. Quick rollback plan: pin traffic to stable `opt-7b-stable-v2`, scale stable up x2 for burst, and dequeue canary.

ops-bot: :gear: Executing route change: `route update /v1/generate -> opt-7b-stable-v2` (progress: 0/3 hosts)

aj: handoff to @aj in-meeting -> actually I need to hand to kevin at 09:11 UTC. kevin, you have context on routing and infra.

kevin: taking over. ops-bot, continue. Also create a temporary traffic-split rule to 0% for canary.

ops-bot: :gear: Traffic-split update applied: canary -> 0%, stable -> 100% (confirmed on control-plane).

kevin: scaling stable pool +2 replicas to absorb traffic.

maria: notify CS and affected customers. Sophia, send short note: "We've identified a regression in canary causing request failures; we've routed all traffic to the last stable model and disabled the canary. We'll follow up with RCA."

sophia: sending now. (cc @support) :email:

aj: recording runbook commands we used for postmortem:

```
# check deployed model checksum
redwoodctl model inspect redwood/opt-7b-canary-v3 --commit
# get cache stats
redwoodctl obs kv-stats --model redwood/opt-7b-canary-v3 --window=5m
```

maria: quick verification after rollback — latency back to baseline within 2 mins. p95 trending down.

aj: Verified by sampling logs (09:12 UTC):

```
2025-11-14T09:12:30Z INFO serve: request_id=efgh5678 handler=token_streaming model=opt-7b-stable-v2 kv_cache_misses=24 p95=198ms
```

kevin: leaving note: we should add a pre-deploy check to block kv_key_prefix changes without a migration step. Also ensure canary tests validate kv_hit_rate in synthetic harness.

maria: adding immediate action items in-thread: 1) Rollback confirmed. 2) Postmortem + timeline. 3) Deploy gate for kv_key_prefix changes. 4) Add canary perf smoke test for kv_hit_rate.

aj: assigning: kevin -> implement deploy gate config (PR), maria -> write timeline + initial RCA draft, sophia -> customer comms & impact list, me (aj) -> instrument synthetic kv_hit_rate check in CI.

kevin: quick check: did we pin model versions in infra? confirm `service.yaml` for routes doesn't auto-latest.

maria: service.yaml for /v1/generate shows `model: "redwood/opt-7b:stable"` (tagged) not digest pinned. That's risky.

kevin: note: for critical routes we should require digest pinning (immutable). Adding to action list.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident mitigated — traffic reverted, error rates normalized. Incident ticket #INC-2025-114 created and linked.

maria: handing off to post-incident RCA cycle. On-call rotation: @aj off at 09:45 UTC, @kevin remains primary until RCA writeup.

aj: will paste raw diffs and full logs into the RCA doc. For completeness: canary commit f1e2d3 changed tokenization shim + kv prefix -> that combination is the cause chain.

sophia: we should proactively notify customers with a summary and ETA for fix (PR + deploy gate + canary re-eval). Drafted message in #support-drafts.

kevin: draft PR title: "deploy-gate: prevent kv_key_prefix changes without migration". Tagging reviewers: @maria, @aj.

maria: thanks everyone. Closing thread once RCA doc link is up. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: :memo: Follow-up action item: RCA doc due in 48h, postmortem review meeting scheduled 2025-11-16 16:00 UTC.
